clips.text: Cassian glanced at the split skin on her knuckles. "With your face?"

He laughed, despite trying not to. Then he cleaned her knee with water from a bottle, tearing a strip from an old cloth when they ran out of proper bandages. She hissed when the cold water touched the scrape. "Hold still, menace."
When he was done, he crouched in front of her and held out his hands.
